Method of Attack: Exploitation of inadequate blocklist logic to alter wp_capabilities user meta value
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Ultimate Member plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Ultimate Member plugin vulnerability
Registration of new accounts with administrative privileges
Indicators of Compromise: Unauthorized administrator accounts with names like apadmins, se_brutal, segs_brutal, wpadmins, wpengine_backup, wpenginer
Malicious plugins and themes uploaded through the administration panel
